faq.question: When are you open?
faq.answer: Mostly we are open from 11:30 till late. Please check our contact us page for latest update.

faq.question: Are you open Sundays?
faq.answer: Mostly we are open 7 days a week. Please check our contact us page for latest update.

faq.question: Do you have baby changing facilities?
faq.answer: We sure do. We are a family restaurant after all!

faq.question: Do you have High Chairs?
faq.answer: Yes. We want your little one to be comfy when dining!

faq.question: Can I bring my dog?
faq.answer: Only if he's a guide dog.

faq.question: Do you have Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Oh yeah! Please ask our staff for details.

faq.question: Can I park my car at your place?
Do you do delivery service?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer delivery within a 5-mile radius with a minimum order requirement.

faq.question: How does it work?
faq.answer: You order online or call us. You receive the food within 45-50 minutes. You can pay online at the time of order or in cash upon delivery.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: It might take 40 to 50 minutes depending on your location, order size, and time of order.

faq.question: Can I pay online?
faq.answer: If you order online, you will be prompted to pay online.

faq.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, you can pay cash on delivery.
